summary.body:
Greptile Summary

This PR adds weighted dependent-graph propagation and exposes its mass, ranking, distance, and concentration results from both analysis endpoints. The propagation currently drops later-path contributions, while concentration conflates chain depth with diffusion. - Adds `computeWeightedBlast` with configurable decay and minimum-mass pruning. - Adds the `weighted` field to `/api/analyze` and `/api/analyze-mock`. - Preserves the existing unweighted blast response. ## Downstream impact - Repository-root API service: weighted results returned by `server.js` can understate affected modules and mischaracterize narrow chains. - No `demo-repo/*` service directly imports the changed files; consumers of the repository-root analysis API receive the incorrect metrics.

Confidence Score: 3/5

The PR is not safe to merge until weighted propagation preserves later-path contributions and concentration stops treating narrow-chain depth as diffusion. The new API field can return understated module weights on cyclic or unequal-length converging paths and reports decreasing concentration for perfectly narrow chains. **Files Needing Attention:** lib/blast-engine.js

Important Files Changed

 | Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | lib/blast-engine.js | Adds weighted propagation, but first-arrival deduplication loses later-path mass and the concentration formula incorrectly penalizes narrow multi-hop chains. | | server.js | Additively exposes weighted results from both analysis endpoints; the wiring is straightforward but propagates the engine's incorrect metrics to API consumers. |

Flowchart

 ```mermaid %%{init: {'theme': 'neutral'}}%% flowchart LR A[Changed module: mass 1] --> B[Reverse dependent traversal] B --> C{Dependent already seen?} C -- No --> D[Accumulate same-hop mass] C -- Yes --> E[Discard later-hop contribution] D --> F[Admit above minMass] F --> G[Retain every hop in ranked] G --> H[Normalize concentration across all hops] E --> I[Understated mass and ranking] H --> J[Chain depth appears as diffusion] ```
